body:
Adds `research/abstention-scoring` (MIT): selective reporting under proper scoring rules with reporting costs.

- Closed-form Brier abstention region `|p−α| < √c`; log-score region by root-finding
- Silence is evidence unless the anchor is a symmetric prior; reporters are a selected sample
- Aggregators that ignore silence get worse as verifiers are added (log-loss 0.62 vs 0.02 at n=12)
- Stale-anchor effect; reward-scale saturation
- 12 tests, deterministic experiments, white paper, README and portfolio page updates
